subject: Tenor rephase and step-up window — Brightwell expansion plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie@brightwell.com>, procurement@brightwell.com
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Tenor rephase and step-up window — Brightwell expansion plan

Natalie / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Brightwell is planning a meaningful capacity expansion for H2 and wants the renewal to align with fiscal planning while preserving predictable unit economics. Attached is a first-pass proposal that shifts the contract tenor and creates a step-up window to unlock additional reserved capacity over 24 months. High-level summary: 

- 24-month rephased term (start: 2028-01-01) to align with Brightwell fiscal year
- Step-up windows at months 6, 12, and 18 that allow Brightwell to add committed GPU capacity at pre-agreed discounts
- Auto-renew clause remains, with an opt-out 60 days prior to renewal
- Early-exit credit for first 12 months to reduce risk of overcommit

Please review the attached spreadsheet (Brightwell_Tenor_Rephase_Proposal_v3.xlsx) — Camila is copied and will run numbers with the finance/ops team. If this structure looks OK, we can produce a short amendment and route to procurement + legal.

Next steps: 
1) Confirm the step-up cadence you want (6/12/18 above is a suggestion).
2) Procurement to confirm PO timing and any specific invoicing cadence.
3) We’ll produce an amendment + updated SOW for signature.

Thanks,
Marcus
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Brightwell_Tenor_Rephase_Proposal_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Natalie Chen <natalie@brightwell.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightwell.com
Date: 2027-09-11T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Tenor rephase and step-up window — Brightwell expansion plan

Marcus,

Appreciate the timely proposal — I shared the spreadsheet with finance and procurement. A few asks from our side before we proceed: 

- Procurement wants the primary renewal to co-term with our FY start (2028-01-01) — that aligns with your suggested start date, so good there.
- Can the step-up windows be made quarterly after month 6 (i.e., 6, 9, 12, 15, 18) rather than only three check-ins? That gives us more flexibility while keeping negotiated pricing for additions.
- We need a clear SLA/ramp assurance from ops for the first 90 days after each step-up so our product launches don’t hit capacity bottlenecks.
- Procurement attached our vendor onboarding form — please complete section C (billing/invoice contacts, PO terms).

If you can confirm the quarterly step-ups and the 90-day SLA commitment (or an ops handoff plan), procurement will fast-track the PO.

Thanks,
Natalie Chen
Director, Cloud Platform
Brightwell Inc.

Attachment: Brightwell_Procurement_Specs.pdf (procurement checklist)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie@brightwell.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T08:20:00Z
Subject: RE: Tenor rephase and step-up window — Brightwell expansion plan

Thanks Natalie — this is helpful. Quick answers and our adjusted proposal notes below. 

Quoted for context:
> Can the step-up windows be made quarterly after month 6 (i.e., 6, 9, 12, 15, 18) rather than only three check-ins?

Yes — we can support quarterly step-ups after month 6. Operationally, we recommend a smaller incremental add at month 9 and 15 (reserve credit bands) and larger additions at 12 and 18 to balance scheduling and provisioning. That reduces churn while giving Brightwell flexibility.

> We need a clear SLA/ramp assurance from ops for the first 90 days after each step-up so our product launches don’t hit capacity bottlenecks.

Kimberly and Jonas are copied — they’ll confirm the ops playbook and SLA commitment. High-level: we can commit to a 99.5% availability target on provisioned capacity and a documented handoff checklist prior to each step-up. For sudden burst demand beyond reserved add-ons, we’ll route to our burst pool and provide a prioritized provisioning window (usually 24–48 hours for standard regions). We’ll call out any region-specific lead times in the amendment.

Proposal changes (we’ll produce v4):
- Quarterly step-up windows at months 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 with named increment tiers
- 90-day SLA commitment on newly provisioned reserved capacity with escalations to a named ops contact
- Amendment will include invoicing cadence options (monthly or quarterly) and an invoice-to-PO mapping section to match your procurement form.

Marcus — once ops confirms the SLA language (Kimberly / Jonas), we’ll send the updated workbook and a one-page amendment draft for legal.

Best,
Camila
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Natalie Chen <natalie@brightwell.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T17:55:00Z
Subject: Operational check — SLA & provisioning for Brightwell step-ups

Kim / Jonas — looping you both here to confirm the operational commitments Camila outlined. Key asks from Brightwell: 

1) 90-day SLA commitment for newly provisioned reserved capacity after each step-up window.
2) Named escalation contact and a provisioning runbook (pre-step-up checklist + post-provision verification).
3) Lead time and process for cross-region provisioning if they decide to add capacity in EU/APAC in later phases.

Can you confirm feasibility and any constraints? If we can commit to the 90-day guardrail and provide the runbook, procurement should sign quickly and we can proceed to DocuSign.

We should also sanity-check pricing bands for the smaller quarterly increments (month 9 and 15) — Camila has the suggested tiers in the workbook.

Thanks,
Marcus
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: procurement@brightwell.com
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Chen <natalie@brightwell.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T10:02:00Z
Subject: RE: Tenor rephase and step-up window — Brightwell expansion plan

Marcus / Camila,

Thanks for the clarifications. Procurement has reviewed the amended terms and confirms Brightwell will proceed on the following basis: 

- 24-month term starting 2028-01-01, co-term with our FY.
- Quarterly step-up windows after month 6 (6, 9, 12, 15, 18) with the smaller incremental tiers at 9 and 15 as you proposed.
- We require the 90-day SLA guardrail documented in the amendment; please include the named ops contact and runbook excerpt.
- PO will be submitted within two business days of receiving the DocuSign link and final amendment.

Please send the amendment and DocuSign package to procurement@brightwell.com (include invoice instructions and our PO reference format). Happy to sign once DocuSign is received.

Procurement Team
Brightwell Inc.
